_comment: Videos for the Get Started pages. Put each file in studenttrustee/media/ with a WebVTT captions file beside it, then set the section's entry to {"src": "/media/name.mp4", "captions": "/media/name.vtt", "poster": "/media/name.jpg"} (poster is optional) and run npm run build. A section whose entry is null shows no video. Captions are required: the site targets WCAG 2.2 AAA.
